entries.module.title: Adjudications
entries.page.title: Adjudications
entries.title: Adjudications
entries.banner.own.label: Your own preview.
entries.banner.own.text: This is the page as you see it, in the second person. A copy that is shared with someone else is drawn in the third person.
entries.bar.label: Contents checked
entries.bar.text: {cited} of {total} adjudication records cite a record in this bundle · {raters} · signatures not checked here
entries.core.label: CORE
entries.lede.own: Adjudications are your pack's blind human sample of judged verdicts. This page shows what each adjudicator said, whether it matches the judge, and how often they agree, with the denominator every time.
entries.lede.shared: Adjudications are the pack's blind human sample of judged verdicts. This page shows what each adjudicator said, whether it matches the judge, and how often they agree, with the denominator every time.
entries.tile.n.label: adjudications
entries.tile.n.label.of: adjudications · of {of} judged verdicts in this bundle
entries.tile.concur.label: concur with the judge
entries.tile.differ.label: do not concur
entries.tile.percent.label: concurrence · derived from the two counts beside it, never stored
entries.blind.all.own: Blind: every adjudication record you hold states it was rated blind, without the judge's verdict.
entries.blind.all.shared: Blind: every adjudication record states it was rated blind, without the judge's verdict.
entries.none.title: No adjudications sampled
entries.none.lead.own: None of your judged verdicts was sampled for adjudication, so there is no agreement to state.
entries.none.lead.shared: None of the judged verdicts was sampled for adjudication, so there is no agreement to state.
entries.term.note: A term is named by its clause reference. Its own wording, and how many verdicts it judged, are not in this bundle.
entries.adjudicator.book.missing: The book and controller each adjudicator answered from are not in this bundle: an adjudication record names its rater only by an opaque reference.
entries.adjudicator.none: The adjudication records themselves are not in this bundle, so no adjudicator is named.
entries.rows.none: The adjudication records themselves are not in this bundle, so no row is drawn.
entries.col.subject: Subject
entries.rows.more.concur.one: {n} more, and it concurs. Differences are listed first.
entries.rows.more.concur.other: {n} more, all concur. Differences are listed first.
entries.panel.judge.words: Its words are not in this bundle: a judged case in an evaluation report carries a verdict, not a rationale.
entries.panel.adjudicator.words: Their words are not in this bundle: an adjudication record carries a label, not text.
entries.panel.not_counted: This answer, {label}, is neither met nor not met, so it is in no count.
entries.panel.unresolved: This record cites a report that is not in this bundle, or one that holds more than one case, so its judge's side is not drawn.
entries.refused.title: These adjudications are not drawn
entries.unverified.lead: This bundle did not pass the page's checks, so nothing from it is drawn.
entries.unreadable.lead: A record this page reads is not in the form it reads, so none of its counts are drawn.
entries.mismatch.lead: The adjudication records in this bundle do not add up to the calibration summary, so none of its counts are drawn.
entries.nosummary.lead: This bundle carries no calibration summary, so there is nothing to state about agreement.
entries.checks.lead: Each line is a check this page ran on this bundle. It checks no record signature.
entries.check.bundle: The bundle's records, disclosures and log position pass the page's gate
entries.check.summary: Each calibration summary is in its schema's form, and every k is at most its n, for agreement and for drift
entries.check.recount: The adjudication records, set against the judge's verdicts, recount to the summary's k and n
entries.bar.none: the adjudication records themselves are not in this bundle · signatures not checked here
entries.lede.summary.own: This is the calibration summary's count of re-grades of your judged verdicts. The adjudication records themselves are not in this bundle, so this page cannot show who re-graded them or what they said.
entries.lede.summary.shared: This is the calibration summary's count of re-grades of the judged verdicts. The adjudication records themselves are not in this bundle, so this page cannot show who re-graded them or what they said.
entries.ambiguous.lead: This bundle carries more than one calibration summary, and without the adjudication records this page cannot tell whether they count the same re-grades twice, so none of its counts are drawn.
entries.check.records: Each adjudication record and each evaluation report is in its schema's form
